description: This file defines the DistributedContext class, which manages a distributed cache context within the OrchardCore framework, including resource management, shared settings handling, and disposal logic.

classes.name: DistributedContext
classes.description: A class managing a distributed cache context, including resource acquisition, release, and disposal, based on tenant settings in OrchardCore.

methods.name: DistributedContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the distributed context, setting up cache based on service availability.

methods.name: WithoutSharedSettings
methods.description: Marks the context as using unshared settings that can be disposed.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the context if not released, incrementing usage count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the context, marking it as unshared and disposing resources.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the context, disposing the inner ShellContext if last owner.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes the context, disposing the inner ShellContext if last owner.
